title: Understanding Variables
content: Variables are symbols that represent unknown or changing values in an equation. In this lesson we explore how to identify variables, write simple algebraic expressions, and translate word problems into equations.

title: Solving One-Step Equations
content: Watch as we walk through solving equations like x + 5 = 12 using inverse operations. Pause and try each example before checking the answer.

title: Solving Two-Step Equations
content: Building on one-step equations, we now combine two operations. Practice isolating the variable step by step with guided examples.

title: Practice: Equation Word Problems
content: Apply what you've learned to real-world scenarios — budgeting, distance, and age problems — by translating them into algebraic equations.

title: Introduction to Linear Graphs
content: Learn how equations relate to lines on a coordinate plane, and how slope and intercept shape the graph of a line.

title: Unit Quiz: Linear Equations
content: A 10-question quiz covering everything from this unit: solving equations, word problems, and graphing basics. You'll need a score of 70% or higher to pass.

title: Cell Structure Overview
content: An introduction to the parts of a cell — nucleus, mitochondria, cell membrane — and their roles in keeping cells alive and functioning.

title: Plant vs Animal Cells
content: Compare and contrast the structures unique to plant cells, like the cell wall and chloroplasts, with those found in animal cells.

title: Cell Division: Mitosis
content: Step through the phases of mitosis and understand why cell division is essential for growth and repair.

title: Lab: Observing Cells Under a Microscope
content: A guided lab activity walking through how to prepare a slide and identify cell structures under magnification.

title: Unit Quiz: Cell Biology
content: A comprehensive quiz covering cell structure, function, and division from this unit.

title: Mesopotamia: The Cradle of Civilization
content: Explore how the Tigris and Euphrates rivers gave rise to some of the earliest cities, writing systems, and legal codes in human history.

title: Ancient Egypt: Pharaohs and Pyramids
content: Discover how the Nile shaped Egyptian society, and how pyramids reflect the era's religious beliefs and engineering skill.

title: The Rise of Ancient Greece
content: Learn how Greek city-states developed early forms of democracy, philosophy, and the arts that still influence us today.

title: The Roman Republic
content: Examine the structure of Roman government before the empire, and how it balanced power between different groups of citizens.

title: Daily Life in Ancient Civilizations
content: A look at food, family, work, and religion across Mesopotamia, Egypt, Greece, and Rome.

title: Unit Quiz: Ancient Civilizations
content: Test your knowledge of the major ancient civilizations covered in this unit.

title: What is Programming?
content: An introduction to what code actually does, how computers execute instructions, and why Python is a great first language.

title: Variables and Data Types
content: Learn how to store information in variables and the difference between strings, integers, and booleans in Python.

title: Conditionals: if, elif, else
content: Understand how to make your program branch and make decisions based on conditions.

title: Loops: for and while
content: Practice repeating actions efficiently using for-loops and while-loops with hands-on examples.

title: Unit Quiz: Python Basics
content: A short quiz covering variables, conditionals, and loops.

title: Finding Your Voice as a Writer
content: Explore what makes a writer's voice unique, and start developing your own through short freewriting exercises.

title: Building Believable Characters
content: Learn techniques for creating characters with depth, motivation, and flaws that feel real to readers.

title: Show, Don't Tell
content: Practice turning flat statements into vivid, sensory scenes that let readers experience the story.

title: Workshop: Peer Feedback
content: Share a short piece of writing and practice giving and receiving constructive feedback.
